source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever this unit is **destroyed** during the opposing player's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), roll a D6 before its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** roll. On a 2+, leave it on the battlefield:

- When the attacking unit has finished shooting, this unit may shoot with **[normal shooting](vsdata:core-rule/normal-shooting)**, at that attacker only.
- After this unit shoots, or as the phase ends if that is sooner, resolve its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** roll, then remove it.

detail.trigger: destroyed in enemy Shooting phase before resolving Deadly Demise

onSuccess.complete: resolve DEADLY DEMISE and remove after this unit shoots or at phase end, whichever occurs first
